sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: A literary critic and author, Raj has worked across editorial practice and support for fellow writers through Literia Insight and The Literary Mirror. Public literary records identify him as Nitish Raj, the name used in his supplied biography. NIT Jalandhar's creative-writing course programme lists him as the author of Love in Modern Times and a resource person for its January 2024 course.

His poem ‘Miraculous Tone’ centres on the consolation of hearing a beloved voice. Repeated questions carry the speaker between remembered closeness and the wish to feel wanted again. The telephone conversation becomes an intimate space in which sound can briefly reach across absence.
